tracks.name: System Design & Architecture
tracks.description: API design, databases, caching, scalability, and trade-offs.

weeks.title: Foundations
weeks.milestone: Write debounce and memoize from memory and explain every line
weeks.notes: These are meant to be a stretch. Finish a first pass of each, then log your confidence honestly.

assignments.title: Closures under pressure
assignments.description: Write memoize with a custom key resolver, debounce with leading and trailing options plus cancel, and a once that preserves this. No lodash, no looking anything up.
objectives: Explain why a closure captures a binding, not a value
Find and fix a stale closure in a timer callback
Pass this and arguments through a wrapper correctly

assignments.title: Rebuild the array methods to spec
assignments.description: Write map, filter, reduce, flat, and flatMap as standalone functions that match the built-ins on sparse arrays, thisArg, a reduce with no initial value, and an empty array.
objectives: Predict what each built-in does with a hole in the array
Write a test that tells your version apart from the built-in, then make it pass

assignments.title: Complexity beyond the single loop
assignments.description: Derive time and space for merge sort, naive and memoized Fibonacci, and your flat from this week. Then show why pushing to a dynamic array is O(1) amortized.
objectives: Solve a recurrence by drawing its recursion tree
Count the call stack as part of space complexity
Explain amortized cost without saying 'on average'

assignments.title: Two Sum three ways, then 3Sum
assignments.description: Solve Two Sum by brute force, with a hash map, and with two pointers on sorted input. Then extend the two-pointer version to 3Sum with no duplicate triplets.
objectives: State the time and space trade-off of each approach before writing it

weeks.title: Async and data structures
weeks.milestone: Explain the event loop out loud in under two minutes

assignments.title: Promises and async/await
assignments.description: Write sleep, retry, and a timeout wrapper. Convert each between .then chains and async/await.
objectives: Trace the order of microtasks and timers
Handle a rejected promise in both styles

assignments.title: Stacks and queues
assignments.description: Implement both on top of an array, then a queue from two stacks.
objectives: Say when each one is the right fit

assignments.title: What happens when you load a URL
assignments.description: Sketch the path from DNS lookup to rendered page and name each hop.
objectives: Place DNS, TLS, the load balancer, and the cache in order
